title: JayV in CI
summary: jayv run works without the window: it applies the gate and the build validator, exits with an error code a pipeline understands and writes a summary for the pull request.
usage: Run jayv run --validate "<request>" in the project folder. The request goes through the entry gate, the agent works in build mode, and the validator runs the project's tests, lint, typecheck and build, sending failures back to the agent up to --max-repairs times (2 by default). Exit codes: 0 passed, 1 the agent failed, 2 validation failed, 3 the gate blocked the request, 4 the gate needs an answer (pass --yes to confirm it), 5 nothing failed but no test proved the change (only with --require-tests). The Markdown summary (gate, agent and model, each check, failing output, changed files, tokens and cost) goes to --summary <file> and, on GitHub Actions, to the job summary; --json <file> writes the full report. On a runner without the app's settings, --agent and --model choose the agent (its CLI and key must be on the runner). --test-command, --lint-command, --typecheck-command and --build-command replace what the validator detects. The example below runs a request by hand and opens a pull request when it passes.
example:
name: JayV
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      request:
        description: What to change
        required: true
jobs:
  jayv:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # The JayV CLI (from the Linux installer) and the agent it drives.
      - name: Install JayV and the agent
        run: |
          gh release download --repo JayV-Coder/jayv-coder-releases --pattern '*_amd64.deb' --output jayv.deb
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ./jayv.deb
          sudo ln -sf "$(dpkg -L "$(dpkg-deb -f jayv.deb Package)" | grep -m1 '^/usr/bin/')" /usr/local/bin/jayv
          rm jayv.deb
          npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Run the request through JayV
        run: jayv run --validate --yes --require-tests --agent claude --model sonnet "${{ inputs.request }}"
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      - name: Open a pull request with the change
        if: success()
        run: |
          git switch -c jayv/${{ github.run_id }}
          git add -A && git commit -m "JayV: ${{ inputs.request }}"
          git push -u origin HEAD
          gh pr create --fill --body-file "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
